# Lenny Winnemuller

> Lenny Winnemuller is an Amsterdam-based coach who teaches long-term investing as a skill. He offers a personal 12-month coaching program for people who already know the financial markets and want to build a disciplined, personal long-term investing system. This is education and coaching only: Lenny gives no investment advice and no buy or sell recommendations.

## Free workshop
- Title: Why Great Investors Study More and Trade Less: The 20-Decision Rule
- Date: Thursday 5 November 2026, two live sessions: 19:30 Amsterdam time (13:30 New York) and 19:30 New York time (16:30 Vancouver)
- Online and free; registration at https://lennywinnemuller.com/workshop/

## About Lenny
- Based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands
- Started as a professional trader at an Amsterdam-based proprietary trading firm, later earned a seat at Peak Capital Trading
- Invests independently for the long term and teaches long-term investing in a Canadian trader education program
- Graduated with honours in Psychology from the University of Amsterdam, specialising in emotion, performance and group behaviour; also holds a degree in entrepreneurship
- Mission: honest and responsible financial education, so students learn to invest independently for the long term
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lennartwinnemuller/
- X: https://x.com/TradingwLenny
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/lennartwinnemuller

## Market updates
- A weekly note for long-term investors on what moved the markets and what it means for long-term investors. No tips, no advice.
- Published weekly at https://lennywinnemuller.com/updates/
- Latest: [Week 42, 2026: CoreWeave, the Gartner warning and rising US inflation](https://lennywinnemuller.com/updates/2026-10-17-coreweave-the-gartner-warning-and-rising-us-inflation/)

## The 12-month coaching program: The Skill of Long-Term Investing
- 12 months of personal 1:1 coaching, fully online, in four phases: foundation; understanding businesses, the market and yourself; valuation and portfolio management; behavior and independence
- Weekly 60-minute 1:1 sessions, weekly study material and assignments, a monthly exam and thesis defense, and 90-minute quarterly reviews
- Students practice in a paper portfolio with $100,000 starting capital from week one
- Deliverables: an Investment Policy Statement, an investment plan with crash playbook and sell rules, a spreadsheet toolkit, investment memos, and a year of documented decisions
- Assessed on process, reasoning and discipline, not on short-term outcomes
- Admission after a free intro call; new students start on 1 December 2026, applications close on 25 November 2026
- 10-day withdrawal with a full refund
